subject.title: feat(discord): add event-edit and event-delete actions

question: Should Discord scheduled-event edit/delete share the existing `channels.discord.actions.events` gate, or require an explicit event-mutation/delete gate before agents can update or cancel scheduled events?
rationale: Both choices are implementable, but the decision changes least-privilege behavior for existing configs that currently allow event creation but did not previously grant event cancellation or metadata mutation.

options.title: Add Explicit Event Mutation Gate
options.body: Require a separate maintainer-approved destructive event action gate or equivalent allowlist semantics before exposing event edit/delete, while preserving existing event create/list behavior.

options.title: Accept Existing Events Gate
options.body: Allow `actions.events: true` to grant create, edit, and delete, but document the broader destructive capability and accept the compatibility/security risk.

options.title: Defer To Granular Gate Design
options.body: Pause this PR until the adjacent Discord granular action-gate work chooses the permanent config shape for destructive Discord actions.

recommendation.title: Add Explicit Event Mutation Gate
recommendation.body: Require a separate maintainer-approved destructive event action gate or equivalent allowlist semantics before exposing event edit/delete, while preserving existing event create/list behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is a public config/security contract, and prior adjacent review context routes that decision through steipete.
